entities.name: Hmong
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Mountain people who migrated from China into Laos, Vietnam, and Thailand to maintain autonomy. They developed elaborate textile art (paj ntaub), animist-Christian syncretism, and fiercely independent communities. CIA-recruited Hmong fought in Laos during the Vietnam War.
